permissions._comment_www: WebFetch(domain:...) matches the host EXACTLY -- it does not cover subdomains, so 'oecd.org' does not permit 'www.oecd.org'. The 2026-08-04 run demonstrated this twice: ictd.ac was fetched successfully while www.ictd.ac was denied, and the licence-register's own URL for that source is the www. form. Every bare registrable domain below therefore carries an explicit www. twin. Entries that already name a subdomain (api.imf.org, papers.ssrn.com, unstats.un.org, ...) get no twin, because a 'www.api.imf.org' does not exist. Adding a domain here that is NOT already listed in this bot's CLAUDE.md 'May touch' section is a capability change and is Benny's call, not a repair. zenodo.org was granted on 2026-08-10 (Benny's decision, and CLAUDE.md's May-touch list was updated in the same change) because the authoritative EXIOBASE 3 licence text lives there and the 2026-08-04 run could not settle a contradiction on exiobase.eu without it. www.rug.nl is still deliberately absent: WIOD is recorded as frozen at its 2016 release, so nothing is being missed by not reaching it.
